quests.title: Board Order: Night Lantern Stock
quests.description: Supply 1 Glow Potion so the night watch can keep the reopened greenhouse and footpaths safely lit.

quests.title: Board Order: Restorative Shelves
quests.description: Supply 1 Healing Draught for the infirmary shelves while the town copes with fatigue and strain.

quests.title: Board Order: Roadside Lanterns
quests.description: Keep 1 Lantern Draught on the board so the lamplighters can top up the footpath lights each night.

quests.title: Board Order: Field Poultices
quests.description: Supply 1 Field Poultice for the repair crews patching the roads before the season turns.

quests.title: Board Order: Light For The Desert Road
quests.description: Leave 1 Fine-or-better Sunscar Glass Elixir on the board. The carters want a lamp that survives the run to the dunes and back.

quests.title: Board Order: A Light That Does Not Flicker
quests.description: Leave 1 Excellent-or-better Resonance Draught on the board. The well crew works below the water table and will not go down behind a lamp that gutters.

quests.title: Standing Order: Outer Road Lanterns
quests.description: The watch's monthly draw. Leave 2 Excellent Nightwatch Lanterns on the board and the town pays the contracted rate without anyone having to ask.

quests.title: Standing Order: Infirmary Draw
quests.description: Mira's contracted resupply. Leave 2 Excellent Purified Draughts on the board and the counter stays stocked for a month without her chasing anybody.

quests.title: Seasonal Order: Laying In
quests.description: The square's winter stock. Leave 2 Fine-or-better Hollow Hearth Tonics on the board and the town has something to hand the crews who are out before light.

quests.title: Commission: One Flawless Pour
quests.description: A single Purified Draught, Excellent, carrying both pure and calm. The buyer has been specific to the point of rudeness and is paying accordingly.

quests.title: Standing Order: Something Settled
quests.description: One Stillkeeper Tonic carrying at least two of calm, cold and pure. Which two is the keeper's business, not the board's.

quests.title: Standing Order: A Lamp That Also Carries
quests.description: One Resonance Draught that both lights and steadies. The survey crew will not carry two bottles up a ladder.

quests.title: Bulk Order: Field Poultices, Three
quests.description: Three poultices, any workable grade. The road crews go through them faster than anyone can make them well.

quests.title: Rush Order: Nothing Fancy, Very Good
quests.description: One Healing Draught at Excellent, carrying restorative and healing both. It is the plainest recipe in the book and the board is paying four times its worth for a perfect one.

quests.title: Unsigned: A Purified Draught, Excellent
quests.description: No name on it. One Excellent Purified Draught, and the note specifies the pour must be clean rather than strong — which is an odd thing for a customer to know to ask for.

completion_milestones.title: No Name On It
completion_milestones.text: Somebody left an unsigned order on the board and paid four times the going rate for a clean pour. Elric checked: nobody in the valley posted it, and it was there before the board was unlocked for the morning.

quests.title: Unsigned: Something Luminous, Held Steady
quests.description: The same hand. A Wardlight Solution, Excellent. The note adds one line: hold it at the bench that favours the work, not the one that is nearest.

completion_milestones.title: That Is Not A Customer's Sentence
completion_milestones.text: The second unsigned note tells the brewer which bench to use. Ione's reading is that customers ask for outcomes and only practitioners ask for method — and that whoever is writing these already knows how this tower works.

quests.title: Unsigned: The Cordial, And Do Not Substitute
quests.description: Third and last. One Excellent Hollowroot Cordial, with the note that no substitution will be accepted — for a plant that stopped existing in this valley before anybody outside it could have known it was back.

completion_milestones.title: Read In Order
completion_milestones.text: Three unsigned orders, read in the order they were posted: a clean pour, the right bench, and a plant that had been extinct for twenty years. It is not a shopping list. It is somebody checking, one item at a time, whether the tower is working again — and they knew what to check before anyone here did.

completion_milestones.title: The Question Nobody Answered
completion_milestones.text: The third order was collected the same night and no fourth has appeared. Whoever was asking got the answer they came for, and has not said what they intend to do with it.

quests.title: Road Crews: Coldiron Tincture, Standing Order
quests.description: The crews working the switchback want tincture that keeps in the wet. Brin has written under the notice, in his own hand, that the lichen takes ten years to cover a hand's width and the order does not say how much is enough. Both notes are still up.

quests.title: Infirmary: Steadyhand Tonics, Four Of Them
quests.description: Not a good tonic. Four identical ones. The note is explicit that the infirmary would rather have four bottles it can predict than one it cannot repeat, and that this is not a compliment about anybody's brewing.

quests.title: Infirmary: One Hollowroot Cordial, And It Must Be Perfect
quests.description: A child on the north road who a good cordial will not be enough for. The note names the band and then apologises for naming it. Brin has written underneath that there are nine hollowroot plants in this valley and that he is not objecting, he is only writing it down.

completion_milestones.title: Named The Band
completion_milestones.text: Somebody asked for the best thing this tower can make, in those words, because good would not have been enough. It is the first order in a year that could not have been filled by trying hard. It had to be filled by having got better.

quests.title: Lyra: A Stillkeeper Tonic, The Best You Have Ever Made
quests.description: In her own hand, which she does not usually use on the board. An animal that a Fine tonic will settle and a Masterwork one will save, and she is explicit that she has spent six years arguing this valley out of exactly this kind of request.

quests.title: Switchback Crews: Trailblaze Tonics, Standing
quests.description: The crews cutting the switchback want the hot one. Four of them, and the note says not to substitute the gentle version because somebody already tried that and the crew walked back down at noon.

quests.title: Market Walk: The Gentle One, And Only The Gentle One
quests.description: Two briskstep draughts for the walk in from the outer row. The note is unusually firm that a stronger tonic is not a better one here, and that whoever sent up trailblaze last time should think about who they were sending it to.

quests.title: Road Crews: Forgestep, And They Know What It Tastes Like
quests.description: An order for the tonic the crews complain about every single time and order again every single week. Brin has stopped asking them why.

quests.title: Carters: Longstride, For The Far Side
quests.description: The carters have worked out what the salvaged one is for. It is not the tonic you take at the start of a haul. It is the one you take when you are already tired and the far side is still four hours off, and they would like a standing supply.

quests.title: Road Crews: Shiftlong, Three At A Time
quests.description: They have stopped asking for the one that tastes better. Three shiftlong tonics, and the note adds that a crew is three people and one of them going without is worse than all three getting something ordinary.

quests.title: Infirmary: Two On The Shelf, Standing
quests.description: Wren's hand, and unusually long for her. Two standing doses, kept on the shelf rather than carried out, for the nights the second room has somebody in it and she is in the first. She notes that she has spent her whole working life arguing against exceptional medicine and is now ordering a bottle that dispenses itself, and asks you not to make anything of it.

quests.title: Archive: One Table, All Of It At Once
quests.description: Unsigned, but the hand is the archive's and it has stopped pretending otherwise. One tablewide reading. The note says the loose sheets have been sorted four times by four different methods and every method agreed, which is the part that has stopped being reassuring.

quests.title: Infirmary: The One You Make Every Week
quests.description: Wren, and she has clearly thought about how to word it. Four healing draughts, and the note says she is not asking for the best one you have ever made -- she is asking for the one you have made so many times that you no longer think about it. She would rather have four identical ordinary bottles than one exceptional one and three guesses.

quests.title: Road Crews: Six Lanterns, All The Same
quests.description: The switchback crews want six lantern draughts and have specified, in a hand that has clearly had this argument before, that they must all burn for the same length of time. A crew that has to guess which of six lamps will go first has six problems. They will pay for the ordinary one, made properly, over anything clever.

quests.title: Archive: Steady Light, Not Bright Light
quests.description: Unsigned again, and by now nobody is pretending. Three glow potions of a consistent burn. The note observes that a reading room lit by a different lamp every evening is a reading room where nobody can tell whether the ink has changed or the light has, and that this has cost the archive more than it would like to put in writing.

quests.title: Board Order: A Light That Flatters Nothing
quests.description: Not on the board where anyone can read it. Two Coldread Solutions, cold and even, and the note says only that she has pages she would rather check than trust. She would not have asked a stranger.

quests.title: Board Order: Something The Shelf Can Hold
quests.description: Two Keptwarm Tonics. The infirmary has been rationing the cold bench for a year and Wren has stopped pretending otherwise in writing, which she would not do for somebody she was still being careful around.

quests.title: Commission: The Winter Stores
quests.description: The board is asking for money as well as work now. Four cold-bench tonics and 900 coins lays in a winter's stock the valley has never once had, held at the waystation and the infirmary both.

completion_milestones.title: Stores, Not Rations
completion_milestones.text: The valley has a winter's stock laid in for the first time in living memory, funded out of the tower's own takings. Tarn pointed out that it is the first year anybody has had to decide where to put things rather than what to do without.

quests.title: Commission: The Reading Room
quests.description: Six archive lights and 1,400 coins turns Ione's corner into a room other people can work in. She has not asked. Brin has, on her behalf, twice.

completion_milestones.title: A Room Other People Can Work In
completion_milestones.text: The archive corner is a reading room. Ione has stopped apologising for the light and started complaining about the noise, which everybody agrees is an improvement. The eleven months sit in the open on the middle table, and people come up to read them.

quests.title: Commission: The Standing Survey
quests.description: Eight resonance draughts and 2,600 coins puts a permanent measure on the valley: bloom counts, well readings and yields, taken every season by people who are paid to take them. Nobody has to notice a collapse by accident again.

completion_milestones.title: Nobody Notices By Accident Again
completion_milestones.text: The valley measures itself now, every season, by people paid to do it. It took a keeper counting eleven where the log said ninety to work out what was happening, and the whole point of the survey is that the next person will not have to be that observant to find out in time.
